author: sindrunas
quote:
A technical disappointment hidden behind impressive graphics.

After more than a decade of development, releasing a game locked at 30 FPS in 2026 is embarrassing. And it can’t even maintain that consistently. Frame drops during driving, gunfights and explosions make the gameplay feel sluggish and outdated. No 60 FPS mode, not even on PS5 Pro. Add clunky controls, overly scripted missions and frustrating bugs, and it’s hard to understand all those perfect scores.

The world looks incredible, sure. But graphics alone don’t make a game a masterpiece. 
Rockstar deserves criticism, not a free pass just because it’s GTA.

author: sindrunas
quote:
Ocarina of Time Remake is an absolutely phenomenal game, and living proof that great game design is timeless.Whether you played the original almost 30 years ago or you're experiencing Hyrule for the very first time, this game is just as magical, engaging, and incredibly **** that's perhaps its greatest achievement: it's genuinely FUN from the very first **** an era where so many modern adventure games expect you to invest four or five hours before things finally "get good," Ocarina of Time reminds us that games don't need endless tutorials, bloated progression systems, or dozens of hours of content to be extraordinary.Every mechanic has a purpose. Every dungeon feels carefully crafted. Exploration is genuinely rewarding, puzzles are clever, progression feels natural, and the world is filled with personality and wonder.There's something incredibly refreshing about a game that respects your time while constantly rewarding your curiosity and intelligence.This isn't a great game for its time. It's a great game. Period. Its brilliance doesn't depend on nostalgia, childhood memories, or historical significance. Someone discovering it today can enjoy it every bit as much as someone who fell in love with it decades ago.Ocarina of Time Remake is a masterclass in pacing, level design, atmosphere, and, most importantly, pure gameplay. Modern game developers could learn a lot from it.
An absolute masterpiece. 10/10.
